/noiseboard.html.title: Noiseboard — Skateboarding & Sound | Nicolò Merendino

/mcgui.html.title: MotionComposer — GUI Design | Nicolò Merendino

/mcc.html.title: MotionComposer — Chassis Design | Nicolò Merendino
/mcc.html.description: Nicolò Merendino’s chassis design for MotionComposer, an accessible device that transforms movement into music for people with different abilities.

/nanoaetherphone.html.title: Nano Aetherphone — Digital Theremin | Nicolò Merendino
/nanoaetherphone.html.description: Nano Aetherphone reinterprets the theremin as a compact digital instrument, using open hardware, open software, and a customizable tangible interface.

/nanoaetherphone2.html.title: Nano Aetherphone II — MIDI Controller | Nicolò Merendino
/nanoaetherphone2.html.description: Nano Aetherphone II is an open-source MIDI controller inspired by the theremin, with a compact physical interface designed for expressive performance.

/b58bpm.html.title: Below 58 BPM — Wearable Musical Interface | Nicolò Merendino
/b58bpm.html.description: Below 58 BPM explores wearable heart-rate feedback and sound processing in opera performance, developed with and for singer Eleonora Amianto.

/cracklesynth.html.title: Crackle Synth 2.0 — Instrument Redesign | Nicolò Merendino
/cracklesynth.html.description: A contemporary redesign of Michel Waisvisz’s Crackle Synth, exploring the instrument’s form, tactile interface, digital fabrication, and portability.

/oddknobs.html.title: Odd Knobs — Tactile Synthesizer Controls | Nicolò Merendino
/oddknobs.html.description: Odd Knobs explores recognizable tactile shapes for synthesizer controls, with five knob designs in two sizes for accessible and expressive interfaces.

/Lampyridae.html.title: Lampyridae — Participatory Sound & Light | Nicolò Merendino
/Lampyridae.html.description: Design and digital fabrication of handheld creatures for Lampyridae, a participatory installation by Matteo Marangoni and Dieter Vandoren.

/lightseq.html.title: LightSeq — Light-Based Musical Interface | Nicolò Merendino
/lightseq.html.description: Design and fabrication for Kacper Ziemianin’s LightSeq: a DIY performance system translating programmed light patterns into electronic music.

/punkidelay.html.title: Punkidelay — DIY Synthesizer Enclosure | Nicolò Merendino
/punkidelay.html.description: A laser-cut polycarbonate enclosure for Punkidelay, a DIY stylophone-style synthesizer based on the Atari Punk Console.

/soniccube.html.title: Sonic Cube — Playful MIDI Interface | Nicolò Merendino
/soniccube.html.description: Sonic Cube uses conductive embroidery, motion sensing, and an ESP32 to turn holding and throwing a soft fabric cube into wireless MIDI interaction.
